source.interpretation: Court outlines are OSM polygons. Green, yellow/blue and red surface families and the low flat roof are interpreted from IPR ortho; line widths, fence heights, post pitch and open access gates are unmeasured game adaptations. Blue tennis markings coexist with source soccer tags; they do not change OSM data. Market/bar door positions remain unverified. No Google texture or 3D tile is redistributed or derived.

shopRoof.provenance: OSM one-storey shell; IPR flat-roof interpretation; existing architecture retains east mural and flue
